name: Shoei Foods Corporation
summary: Shoei Foods Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, procures, processes, manufactures, sells, and imports food products in Japan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers fruits, including prunes, raisins, cranberries, blueberries, strawberries, mandarin oranges, lemons, mangoes, grapefruits, figs, dates, cherries, apples, apricots, grapes, raspberries, goji berries, pineapples, papayas, goldenberries, gingers, bananas, cherry tomatoes, aloes, mixed fruits, peaches, and pears; and nuts such as almonds, almond milk, walnuts and processed walnut products, macadamia nuts, cashews, hazelnuts, pecan nuts, pistachio nuts, coconuts, pine nuts, and sunflower and pumpkin…
